characters.habit: Nearly glabrous to hairy wetland plant, to 1 m or taller
characters.leaves: Blades narrowly lanceolate to narrowly ovate; petioles 0–10 mm
characters.flowers: Petals 5–16 mm; genus key gives four sepals/petals and eight stamens
characters.fruit: Capsules 17–45 mm, pedicels 0–10 mm; seeds 0.6–0.75 mm without horseshoe-shaped endocarp tissue
characters.diagnosis: Compare L. leptocarpa: usually four-merous vs five-merous, smaller seeds without horseshoe-shaped endocarp; L. octovalvis also has long fruit.

characters.habit: Ascending or creeping wetland plant, rooting at nodes
characters.leaves: Opposite; elliptic-lanceolate, acute and entire or nearly entire; petioles 2–10 mm
characters.flowers: Sessile, petals absent, four calyx lobes
characters.fruit: Capsules 2–8 mm long; genus key: sessile with broad green corner bands
characters.diagnosis: Both L. palustris and L. repens have opposite leaves, but palustris is petal-less with sessile capsule and characteristic green bands. Petal absence not sufficient alone per existing research.
